# Sunrise Human Care Services
> Mental health clinic in Darby, PA, providing expert therapy and psychiatry.

## Core Services
- [Individual Therapy](https://sunrisehumancare.com/individual-therapy-darby-pa): Personalized counseling for anxiety, depression, and trauma in PA.
- [Couples Counseling](https://sunrisehumancare.com/couples-counseling-darby-pa): Relationship and marriage counseling for couples in Delaware County.
- [Family Therapy](https://sunrisehumancare.com/family-therapy-darby-pa): Support for families navigating conflict and communication issues.
- [Psychiatric Evaluations](https://sunrisehumancare.com/psychiatric-evaluations-darby-pa): Comprehensive mental health assessments by board-certified psychiatrists.
- [Medication Management](https://sunrisehumancare.com/medication-management-darby-pa): Expert oversight for psychiatric medications.

## Conditions Treated
- Anxiety Disorders
- Major Depression
- PTSD & Trauma
- ADHD (Children & Adults)
- Bipolar Disorder
- OCD & BPD
